answer.book: Antoine de Chandieu's (Sadeel's) 1592 reply to Laurentius Arturus's three books on the Church: one work built as an address to the reader, a preface, two appended sections (on digressions and on calumnies), and twelve numbered chapters that refute Arturus point by point, closing with a Finis.
